description.zh: 干员皮肤素材：Spine 战斗模型（正/背面）+ 头像 + 半身像 + 立绘——全部来自本机客户端的提取产物。由使用者提取后本地构建，不随仓库或发布包分发。纯外观插件：服主安装，每个玩家在自己的浏览器里开启；没开启的人看到的是默认，包括看别人的。不改任何对局。（插件单包上限 200 MB，全部皮肤拆成 3 个包，这是第 1 个，装 97 套。）
description.en: Operator skin assets: Spine battle models (front/back) + avatars + portraits + illustrations — all extracted from the local client. Built locally by the user after extracting them; never shipped with the repository or a release package. Cosmetic only: the server owner installs it, each player switches it on in their own browser; without it everything is the default, other players included. (One plugin folder may hold 200 MB, so all skins are split into 3 packages; this is package 1 of 3, 97 skins.)
